hebrewText: קַ֥מְתִּֽי אֲנִ֖י לִ/פְתֹּ֣חַ לְ/דוֹדִ֑/י וְ/יָדַ֣/י נָֽטְפוּ מ֗וֹר וְ/אֶצְבְּעֹתַ/י֙ מ֣וֹר עֹבֵ֔ר עַ֖ל כַּפּ֥וֹת הַ/מַּנְעֽוּל

tokens.bdb: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
tokens.kjv: abide, accomplish, [idiom] be clearer, confirm, continue, decree, [idiom] be dim, endure, [idiom] enemy, enjoin, get up, make good, help, hold, (help to) lift up (again), make, [idiom] but newly, ordain, perform, pitch, raise (up), rear (up), remain, (a-) rise (up) (again, against), rouse up, set (up), (e-) stablish, (make to) stand (up), stir up, strengthen, succeed, (as-, make) sure(-ly), (be) up(-hold, -rising).
I, (as for) me, mine, myself, we, [idiom] which, [idiom] who.

tokens.bdb: to open wide (literally or figuratively); specifically, to loosen, begin, plough, carve
tokens.kjv: appear, break forth, draw (out), let go free, (en-) grave(-n), loose (self), (be, be set) open(-ing), put off, ungird, unstop, have vent.

a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),

myrrh (as distilling in drops, and also as bitter)
something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe

to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
